Overview.Name: Swecha Valluripally
Overview.Goal: Improve energy levels and mental wellbeing with steady fat loss.

Early_Morning: Option 3: Plain tea or coffee (no sugar)
Meal_2_Lunch: Option 1: Plain rice (small portion) + chicken curry + vegetables
Option 2: Plain rice (small portion) + egg curry + vegetables
Option 3: Plain rice (small portion) + dal + cooked vegetables
Meal_3_Dinner: Option 1: Egg curry + small portion plain rice + cooked vegetables
Option 2: Chicken curry + small portion plain rice + vegetables
Option 3: Dal + small portion plain rice + cooked vegetables

Notes_and_Tips: Late nights and stress increase cravings; keep dinner timing fixed.
For sweet and savory cravings, start meals with protein.
Avoid fried foods most days as they trigger overeating.
Simple, repeatable meals work best with shift schedules.
Focus on energy and routine first; fat loss will follow.
